description: Graphe de la mobilité - Graphe ferroviaire is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Kanton Genf. GRAPHE DE LA MOBILITE - GRAPHE FERROVIAIRE: Le graphe de la mobilité est un regroupement des graphes de base, qui sont la forme géométrique des troncons, et des différentes jonctions (carrefours, arrêts, gares, débarcadères) qui sont les points de connexions, de transferts entre les différents graphes. Coverage: Kanton Genf. The portal files it under the publisher Kanton Genf. It offers 9 resource(s) in API, CSV, GML, KML, SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is opendata.swiss terms of use: open use. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
